display.purpose: The tape window's hero VFD figure (Quick Add amount) — the machine's main readout.

figures.purpose: Every displayed number; the VFD display face.

body.purpose: Prose and descriptions; global tabular numerals.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The single shared focus indicator (:focus-visible), quiet double-ring.

shadows.name: fab-halo-dark
shadows.purpose: Phosphor halo under the FAB in dark mode.

shadows.name: fab-halo-light
shadows.purpose: Ordinary ink lift for the FAB on paper; no glow in light mode.

shadows.name: vfd-resting-glow
shadows.purpose: Resting text-shadow bloom on .figures-glow; dark only.

motion.name: flash
motion.purpose: One-shot keypress flicker when the machine registers a save; settles to resting glow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Phosphor fill, casing-ink text; the machine's one loud voice.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--phosphor); color: var(--ink); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 0 0 3px var(--phosphor); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered tape button; border sharpens to ledger on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--tape); color: var(--ledger); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--dim); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ledger); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 0 0 3px var(--phosphor); outline: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Debit-fill confirm for destructive actions only.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--debit); color: var(--ink); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 0 0 3px var(--phosphor); outline: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet dim action that lifts to ledger with a line wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--dim); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ledger); background: rgb(var(--line-rgb) / 0.4); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 0 0 3px var(--phosphor); outline: none; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Casing-fill field on tape surfaces with plate label and error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-plate { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); } .ds-input { background: var(--ink); color: var(--ledger); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 0 0 3px var(--phosphor); outline: none; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--debit); } .ds-error { color: var(--debit); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: A segment of paper tape: hairline-bordered, padded, rows divided.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--tape); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 12px 0; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid rgb(var(--line-rgb) / 0.5); } .ds-plate { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); } .ds-dim { color: var(--dim); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-figure { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--phosphor); } .ds-figure-negative { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--debit); }

components.name: VFD Figure
components.description: The signature: phosphor mono digits with a resting amber bloom (dark only).
components.css: .ds-vfd { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: 32px; color: var(--phosphor-bright); text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.35), 0 0 11px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.10); transition: text-shadow 250ms ease-out; } .ds-vfd:hover { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.8), 0 0 22px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.32); }

components.name: FAB (The Keypad +)
components.description: The adding machine's only physical key: phosphor circle, dark-only halo, scaling + glyph.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Add transaction"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--phosphor); color: var(--ink); border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(var(--phosphor-rgb) / 0.3), 0 8px 24px -4px rgb(var(--phosphor-rgb) / 0.5); transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-fab svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-fab:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-fab:hover svg { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 0 0 3px var(--phosphor); outline: none; } @media (pointer: fine) { .ds-fab:hover svg { transform: scale(1.05); } }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Machine-glyph motif (▮▯▯▯) in VFD glow over a dim message; aria-hidden decoration.
components.html:
▮▯▯▯

No transactions yet
components.css: .ds-empty { text-align: center; padding: 48px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-empty-glyph { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--phosphor-bright); text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.35), 0 0 11px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.10); margin: 0 0 2px; } .ds-empty-msg { font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--dim); margin: 0; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--phosphor); color: var(--ink); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 12px; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }

components.name: Overflow Menu
components.description: Context menu: tape panel with line border, scale-in entrance, full keyboard navigation.
components.css: .ds-menu-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-menu-trigger { position: relative; padding: 8px; margin: -4px; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--dim); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-menu-trigger::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; } .ds-menu-trigger:hover { color: var(--ledger); background: rgb(var(--line-rgb) / 0.4); } .ds-menu-trigger svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; display: block; } .ds-menu-panel { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 4px); width: 160px; background: var(--tape); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; z-index: 20; transform-origin: top right; animation: ds-scale-in 150ms ease-out; overflow: hidden; } .ds-menuitem { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 9px 12px; background: none; border: none; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ledger); cursor: pointer; } .ds-menuitem:hover, .ds-menuitem:focus-visible { background: rgb(var(--line-rgb) / 0.4); outline: none; } .ds-menuitem-danger { color: var(--debit); } @keyframes ds-scale-in { from { transform: scale(0.96); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Notchy is a mechanical adding machine: a warm near-black casing, amber phosphor VFD figures, oxblood debit ink, engraved faceplate labels. Money is not decoration on cards; it is glow on a calculator tape.

The metaphor is carried hardest where money is displayed (dashboard readouts, Quick Add's tape, account balances) and more quietly in workhorse surfaces (lists, forms). Dark is the native surface; light mode is the paper variant of the same machine — same parts, different material. Glow belongs to the dark casing; paper does not glow.

If a decision could belong to any fintech app unchanged, it is wrong. Ask what the machine would do.
keyCharacteristics: Eight tokens are the whole palette; every surface is a relationship between casing and paper.
Every figure is set in mono tabular numerals; numbers are content, not decoration.
Depth comes from tonal layering and engraved borders, not shadows.
Motion is three keyframes, 150–250ms, all with a reduced-motion story.
The icon vocabulary is typographic glyphs with fixed meanings, never emoji chrome.

rules.name: The Eight-Token Rule
rules.body: These eight tokens are the whole palette. No new accent hues; if a decision needs a ninth color, the decision is wrong.

rules.name: The Measured Contrast Rule
rules.body: --line must clear 3:1 against --tape in both themes, and --dim stays above --line so secondary text reads stronger than a divider.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Every monetary value renders through .figures + formatCurrency. Never set a number in the sans face.

rules.name: The No-Glow-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Glow renders in dark mode only; light mode substitutes plain color or ink shadow. No animation without a reduced-motion story.

dos: Do keep money as integer smallest units through formatCurrency.
Do pair every color-coded state with a glyph or text.
Do give hover-revealed controls a keyboard path and keep them visible on coarse pointers.
Do add locale strings to both messages/en.json and messages/vi.json in the same change.
Do frame irreversible actions numerically before confirming.
donts: Don't introduce floating-point money, new accent hues, or a second semantic red.
Don't render glow, flicker, or halos in light mode; don't ship motion without a reduced-motion story.
Don't use confirm dialogs without consequence framing, or destructive actions without undo or explicit numeric restatement.
Don't mix arbitrary emoji into chrome; status glyphs stay in the glyph vocabulary.
Don't let internal identifiers leak into copy.
